image_description: A Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near a coral reef. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a golden yellow posterior body and tail with a distinct black margin on the caudal fin. The background consists of textured red and green corals and rocky substrate.
